chain: Chain C - Creator Project Workspace (arrangement draft vertical slice)
explicitNonClaim: This feature implements a project data model and a real MIDI file exporter. It does NOT implement or claim a 'Musical Brain', arrangement intelligence, or any guarantee that exported arrangements are musically or professionally acceptable. validateProject() refuses to accept any project missing the three truth labels above.
realBehaviorProven: createProject/addTrack/addNoteEvent/addSection/addChordSymbol assemble a real multi-track, multi-section, multi-role (melody/chord/bass/drums) arrangement draft.
SAVE/CLOSE/REOPEN round-trip via Batch 1's real AtomicSave preserves the project byte-for-byte (deepEqual), proven both for a single track and for a full 4-role, 2-section arrangement.

exportStandardMidiFile() produces a REAL Standard MIDI File (Format 1): genuine MThd/MTrk chunk structure, genuine 7-bit variable-length-quantity delta-time encoding, genuine note-on/note-off status bytes, genuine end-of-track meta event.

parseStandardMidiFile() independently parses the exported bytes back into channel/pitch/velocity/tick events -- tests assert on the PARSED content, not merely that a file was produced, and the round-tripped tick/pitch/velocity/channel values are asserted exactly equal to the source events.
MIDI event range validation rejects out-of-range pitch (>127), velocity (0 or >127), and channel (>15) at project-build time, before export is ever attempted.

parseStandardMidiFile() itself rejects a truncated byte stream, a buffer missing the MThd header, and an unsupported/corrupted MIDI status byte -- proven with deliberately malformed inputs, not merely a well-formed happy path.

FAILURE RECOVERY: an invalid save attempt (e.g. an out-of-range tempoBpm) is rejected by validateProject() before AtomicSave is ever invoked, and the previously-saved project on disk is proven byte-for-byte intact afterward.

DETERMINISM: two logically identical arrangements assembled via a different insertion order (tracks added in reverse order) export to byte-identical Standard MIDI Files; two musically distinct arrangements (one has an extra note) never export identical bytes.
reuseOverReimplementation: atomicSaveSync imported directly from Batch 1's atomic_save_implementation.mjs
